{{Quote|First time racing, rookie poodoo?|Fud Sang, a member of the species, speaking in an alien dialect|translated=1|audio=FudSang-taunt.flac|<ref name="E1R" />}}
A [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''pudgy beings''' existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The aliens were equipped with [[Limb/Legends|legs and arms]] that were nearly twice the height of their own bodies. One well known member of the species was the [[Prisoner/Legends|criminal]] [[Fud Sang/Legends|Fud Sang]], an inmate at a maximum security [[Desolation Alley|prison]] located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]]. Sang also participated in [[Podracing/Legends|Podraces]] that were hosted in the [[Prison/Legends|prison]].

==Biology and appearance==
A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], who were identifiable by round bodies, which also served as their heads. At least one member of the species, [[Fud Sang/Legends|Fud Sang]], exhibited a rather short height, deep [[Color/Legends|purple]] skin, and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] that were white with black irises. The species had two eyes which were placed at the end of two retractable and poseable eye-stalks which protruded from the tops of their bodies. They also had slender snouts which peaked underneath the stalks. A small mouth filled with flattened [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] sat at the end of the snout. Two nostrils existed above the mouth, on top of the snout.<ref name="E1R" />

In addition, the members of the species had four [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], two which served as arms and two which served as legs. Each limb had four digits. The arms were considerably longer than the legs, and came from shoulders which stuck out of either side of the species' body. An elbow joint separated the upper arm from the lower arm and hand. Their short legs were bent inwards at the knee.<ref name="E1R" />

==History==
The species evolved somewhere in the galaxy,<ref name="E1R" /> and by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], they had found themselves to be a part of the galactic community.<ref name="E1R" />

==The species in the galaxy==
{{Quote|Fud Sang is down there. Well, I thought he was serving four life sentences here at Oovo IV.|Fode Annodue, a Troig race commentator, remarking on Fud Sang's incarceration on Oovo IV|audio=Fode-FudSang.flac|<ref name="E1R" />}}
[[File:Fud_Sang_the_Magnificent.png|150px|A statue in Fud Sang's likeness|left|thumb]]
By the year 32 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the species had found their way into the galactic spotlight with the help of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the species known as Fud Sang. Sang was a convicted [[Prisoner/Legends|criminal]], and after being arrested by authorities, Sang was incarcerated at a maximum security [[Prison/Legends|prison]] located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]], a prison known as [[Desolation Alley]]. Sang would go on to serve four back-to-back life sentences for his crimes. However, the species' publicity was not all bad. Sang was allowed by the prison [[Warden/Legends|warden]] [[Fenn Booda]] to participate in the [[Podracing/Legends|Podraces]] that Booda hosted at the Alley. Sang was talented enough to gain the favor of his fellow inmates,<ref name="SWNG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer Official Nintendo Player's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'' Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]</ref> and he was eventually allowed to race on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet of [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]].<ref name="E1R2">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']] Gameboy Color version</ref>

Sometime before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which took place during 32 BBY, Sang was honored with a small replica of himself, which could be obtained by Podracing enthusiasts to display. One such enthusiast was the young [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Human/Legends|boy]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who kept one of the Sang statues on his bedroom desk alongside the sculpture of a [[Ronto/Legends|Ronto]].<ref name="PH1">{{Twitter|infinata|status/385478371443884033|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|nobackup=1}}</ref><ref name="PH2">{{Twitter|infinata|status/385614563556589569|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|nobackup=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:FudSangart.png|150px|Concept art from ''The Phantom Menace''|right|thumb]]
The species appeared in the [[1999]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars Episode I: Racer'']] in the form of Fud Sang. Concept art for the species appeared on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] around [[2001]], appearing under the entry for [[Ody Mandrell/Legends|Ody Mandrell]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|odymandrell|Mandrell, Ody}}</ref> Despite the pre-production art, in the 1999 film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the species ultimately only appeared in the form of a small statue that could be seen during the scenes that took place in [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] bedroom. [[Pablo Hidalgo]] later confirmed that the statue represented the species' only known member, Fud Sang,<ref name="PH1" /><ref name="PH2" /> and was originally created for [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="PHROTJ1">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1590583722071687168|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|archivedate=20230719173840}}</ref><ref name="PHROTJ2">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1518452599208353792|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|archivedate=20220425045220}}</ref>

In a [[2006]] [[Star Wars: Blogs]] article titled ''Alien species concepts that became part of the SW universe'' written by [[Tim Veekhoven]] as a part of his Source Blog series, Fud Sang was mentioned as being a member of the Sanhueli species, hailing from Hueli IV. The blog detailed out several Podracer [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who did not make into the final script for the 1999 film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], using material that may have come form early draft material for ''The Phantom Menace''. Due to the fact that the information was from early drafts of the film, and did not make it into the final cut, the information, including the names Sanhueli and Hueli IV, was considered non-canon.<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|teekay-421|69|Alien species concepts that became part of the SW universe}}</ref>
